### Classified Ad: ATTENTION! NEW OFFERS!

I offer a real treat for everyone working with 3.5" DD disks: bright orange floppy disks from ELV at a price of 5 DM per pack of 10 + postage. Minimum order quantity: 3 packs of 10 disks each (due to shipping costs). The disks are brand-new and shrink-wrapped.

In addition, keyword keyboard stickers for the +2, +2A/B, +3, C and similar models are still available in color at 9 DM + 1 DM letter postage.

And for all owners of the 48K in the "Plus" case or the 128K, there are new replacement keys available in case yours are worn out or broken. Single key: 1 DM; complete set: 25 DM.

Peter C. Rennefeld, Genhodder 19, 41179 Mönchengladbach, Germany  
Tel.: 02161/571141 (Answering machine)

***

### ATTENTION! Still in stock:

* A few **ZX Microdrives** at the sensationally low price of 15 DM each (price includes postage & packaging).
* **RAM TURBO Interface** for 2 joysticks (Sinclair 1, 2, Kempston standard, or programmable to Cursor Joystick; unfortunately not compatible with +D). Features a pass-through bus and ROM cartridge slot. Only 15 DM. Very few units remaining.
* Many games from the former stock of Sintech and Blutsch Computers at very low prices, starting from 10 öS (Austria only).
* **3.5" HD floppy drives** for MB02 and other disk interfaces: 300 öS + postage.
* **3" floppy disks**, used, 40 öS each. Very, very few left. Untested!
* Printer and typewriter ribbons, all in original packaging and unused, very few left:
  * EPSON HX 20 (5 DM)
  * TRIUMPH/ADLER SE 1005, 1010, 1011, 1030, 1040, 1041, TRD 170 / ROYAL-IMPERIAL SE 5010, SKA, Robotron S 6010, 6011, Sanyo Serd 20 and similar (8 mm, 270 m) Gr. 185 P (10 DM)
  * IBM 196 C – 16.5 mm (10 DM)
  * WANG 2281 W, 5541 W, WC; 5581 WC, WD; 6581 W, WC; 5577 / Daisywriter DW 20 etc. – 8 mm / 150 m, Gr 220 (10 DM)
  * Olivetti Ink Roller for Logos 3./4., Divisumma 3./4. (5 DM)
  * Olivetti Logos 40 to 49, 60, 62 (new series), 75B, 75S, 80 / Alphacom TU 10, Honeywell P.O.S. terminal, Hugin 3200, 4200 / Olivetti-Divisumma 31P – 5 mm, 0.23 m
  * Facit Correct 80 / 8001 – 8 mm (10 DM) (long ribbon, can possibly be adapted for other printers, e.g. Citizen Swift 24)
  * STAR LC 24 Color (four-color ribbon for color printers): 25 DM

Please call beforehand to verify availability.

**Wanted:**
* TWOFACE or another interface that allows switching between two disk interfaces (+D and MB02).
* Teletext and 80-column card (was once offered in *Happy Computer* magazine).
* Software wanted: DARK EMPIRE, BASIC COMPILER for SAM Coupe (PD versions welcome).

L. C. D., Prager Str. 92/11/12, A-1210 Wien, Austria  
Tel: 0043 1-272 34 63 (Evenings)

***

### Guido Schell (08.01.1997)

Auf dem Stocke 37, D-32584 Löhne, Germany  
Bank details: Kreissparkasse Herford, BLZ 494 501 20, Account: 122 156 81 63

**For Sale:**
* **TASCALC +3** — Spreadsheet program for ZX Spectrum +3 (3" disk): 18 DM incl. postage.

* **Books:**

  * *50 Programme für den ZX Spectrum*, ZX POWER Cooperation, by Roger Valentine: 10 DM incl. postage.
  * *ZX Spectrum Maschinencode* (Birkhäuser) by Ian Stewart and Robin Jones: 10 DM incl. postage.
  * User manual for ZX Spectrum 48K, German, from Profisoft: 8 DM incl. postage.
  * *Das große Floppybuch* (for VC1541), Data Becker, 326 pages: 12 DM incl. postage.

**Wanted Software (for ZX Spectrum / Schneider CPC):**  
Risc (Risk), Colonial Conquest, Arcade Creator (Argus Press Software), Just Imagine (Central Solutions), The Bulge - Battle for Antwerp (Argus Press Software), Das U-Boot (US Gold), Convoy (Budgie), Afghan Attack (Southern Software), Crusade in Europe, Desert Fox, Knights of the Desert (SSI/US Gold), Battle for Normandy (SSI/US Gold), Tigers in the Snow (SSI/US Gold), Combat Leader (SSI/US Gold), Stratego, as well as any strategy and simulation games (PD included).

**Wanted Hardware:**  
A mouse for the ZX Spectrum that works with the +D interface. A cheap ZX Spectrum +3 (even defective).

All programs and books available for trade, sale, or purchase. Software trades for originals only. Some software on my list is very cheap — that doesn't mean it is bad! I bought it cheaply and want to pass it on cheaply.  
For orders under 20 DM, please add 6 DM for postage. Orders of 20 DM or more are post-paid.
